# Canonical card identifiers

[Module map](../README.md) · [Source directory](../../../packages/sku)

Parse, build and normalize Cambridge card SKUs with shared game, set and rarity vocabulary.

**Scope:** Identifier syntax and normalization; a valid identifier alone does not prove catalog membership or data rights.

**Placement:** pnpm workspace member; package `@cambridge-tcg/sku`.

## Progress

Source review recorded **2026-09-28**. Parser, builder, normalization and vocabulary modules plus tests are present. 2026-09-29: shared raw/normalized syntax identity and JSON Schema are consumed by game-specific search and card composition; stored identifiers and printing choices are preserved.

This records source and documentation evidence. It does not establish deployment, external access, service health, or passing tests.

**Next review:** Preserve syntax and stored identifiers while introducing separately evidenced printing mappings. Registry declarations do not establish live coverage; workspace code does not establish an npm release.
